summary: Built the responsive UI of a resume builder web app in HTML, CSS and JavaScript.
headline: My first internship: a resume builder for students
intro: A short remote internship where I built the user interface of a resume builder platform that let college students create customizable resumes.

sections.title: What I did
items: Designed and built a responsive UI for the resume builder
Joined weekly team meetings to discuss progress and blockers
Wrote status reports on completed work, next goals and blockers
